title: Eleven Stars, the Sun and the Moon Bowed to a Boy

meta.name: v5_y12_01_the-dream
meta.title: Eleven Stars, the Sun and the Moon Bowed to a Boy

lines.text: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon, all bowing to a boy.
A boy named Yūsuf wakes from a dream.
O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me.

quran.ar: یَـٰۤأَبَتِ إِنِّی رَأَیۡتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبࣰا وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَ رَأَیۡتُهُمۡ لِی سَـٰجِدِینَ

lines.text: O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan.

quran.ar: یَـٰبُنَیَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡیَاكَ عَلَىـٰۤ إِخۡوَتِكَ فَیَكِیدُوا۟ لَكَ كَیۡدًاۖ

lines.text: Not every dream is for everyone.
